target_state: integrated canonical source; runtime validation gated
phase: body reconstruction implemented and statically verified

implementation.state: clears one level bit from receiver key words and invokes the refresh port

observed_original_abi.receiver_use: EDX saves ECX, and the receiver is the base of the key-bit array.

live_provenance.analysis_basis: Read-only live Ghidra queries against the open x86:LE:32 program.
live_provenance.decompile: The imported signature exposes this, int vkCode, and a four-byte modifier value; the live assembly is authoritative for the unsigned key bound and receiver-array indexing.
live_provenance.disassembly: Save ECX in EDX, load vkCode from ESP+4, reject unsigned values above 0xff, AND the inverse of 1 shifted by vkCode&0x1f into receiver+((vkCode>>5)*4), then call 0x006979c0 with ECX receiver and RET 8.

vtable_evidence.limit: The live function xref query returned direct call references only; no vtable data xref was returned.

observed_execution_order.operation: if vkCode > 0xff, return without state or callback mutation
clear the level bit at receiver+(vkCode>>5)*4

state_contract.invalid_key_behavior: negative signed values and values above 255 are treated as unsigned values above 255 and leave state unchanged
state_contract.modifier_behavior: the incoming modifier word is not stored by this function

runtime_gate.condition: Observe receiver validity, key-domain inputs, and the native 0x006979c0 refresh state in the original input owner.
